data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Contradiction. The isolated context (03f8b3f2f004) stands in direct contradiction to the evolutionary selection mechanism proposed in SRC_003. While SRC_003 grounds preference in survival traits and meta-methodological success, the isolated context asserts a static, axiomatic convention devoid of evolutionary feedback. REFUTED IF: The isolated context can be shown to implicitly rely on the stability of the environment or the correlation between survival and truth-likeness, which would make it compatible with, rather than contradictory to, the evolutionary view.
